name: type-safe-automation
description: Automated type safety and contract synchronization for TanStack Start

scripts.types:generate: pnpm run types:routes && pnpm run types:contracts && pnpm run types:validate
scripts.types:routes: tanstack-router generate && echo '✓ Route types generated'
scripts.deps:visualize: madge src --image deps-graph.svg && echo '✓ Dependency graph generated: deps-graph.svg'
scripts.deps:circular: madge src --circular && echo '✓ No circular dependencies found'
